Client confirms this is a material blocker that should have been escalated immediately. This is an open blocker ageing beyond one sprint with named owner but unresolved, meeting Medium not Good.

rebuttals.argument: The challenger is correct. The firewall blocker was cleared, but Sameer's resignation on 22 September created a new critical-path blocker. By 29 September the backfill remains unconfirmed. The engagement manager admits the escalation was late. An open blocker with named owner but ageing beyond one sprint fits Medium, not Good.

evidence.text: No sign-off has been requested in this period and none will be given until the defect picture improves materially.
Yes. No conditions. Full acceptance of the Phase 1 deliverables.

rebuttals.argument: The client's statement is prospective: no sign-off will be given *until* defects improve. No deliverable has been submitted and rejected. Phase 1 was accepted formally with no conditions. The rubric Poor definition requires deliverables rejected or sign-off withheld for actual submissions. Prospective withholding does not meet that threshold. Poor rating stands.
